facts.fact: The DPC enforced registration obligations under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) on 2026-10-12, per MyJoyOnline.

Ghana's Data Protection Commission ran an enforcement operation on 2026-10-12 and directed Nyaho Medical Centre to report to the Police CID over its expired data protection registration certificate, under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), per MyJoyOnline.
